Nestled in a peaceful countryside town, a quirky human herbalist unexpectedly finds herself sharing a cozy cottage with a trio of clumsy, pastel-colored dragons who love nothing more than baking pastries and napping in the sun. As they navigate the gentle rhythms of daily village life, the lovable reptiles use their tiny, harmless magic to solve minor neighborhood mishaps and brew the ultimate cups of comfort tea. This heartwarming slice-of-life comedy celebrates the joy of found family, quiet afternoons, and the magic found in the simplest moments.
